name: Mealycup Sage
desc: Mealycup Sage (Salvia farinacea): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 8 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Salvia farinacea, the mealycup sage, or mealy sage, is a herbaceous perennial native to Nuevo León, Mexico and parts of the United States including Texas and Oklahoma.
